title: One index-file version bump for alignment and the parts file, or two?
body:
Padding the header for alignment (sail-bb932e) and adding the list file (sail-a59d6f) both change what sits on disk.

1. One bump: land both as VERSION 2. One older layout to keep reading.
2. Two bumps: each lands on its own. Two older layouts to read for as long as the format exists.

Lean: the question dissolves if sail-9d931d goes by reference. The list file is then its own file with its own magic and version. The .saidx layout changes once, for alignment.
